item.text: Set a “landing strip” along one wall: place a washable runner or tray there and assign each roommate one third. Keep only the pair currently in use in that zone; move seasonal or rarely worn shoes to bedrooms. Put a small basket or tote beside the door for slippers, sandals, or loose items. Agree that the doorway itself stays completely clear, and do a quick weekly reset to return stray shoes to owners’ rooms.
